direction: Fifteen varied candid documentary-style illustrations grounded in Episodes 119-128. Mix distant room views, object scenes, and natural group moments. Preserve character identity from repository portraits where supplied. Avoid posed repetitive closeups.

images.prompt: Wide candid photo from a hallway doorway: Tarik standing beside a whiteboard with seven map names handwritten, several players seated at PCs in the background. Real private gaming mansion converted practice room, nobody looking at camera, no tactics.

A long-distance phone photo from high in the stands at an LA Galaxy match, crowd and field dominate, a few friends in the row below seen from behind. Natural stadium lighting, no readable signs, not a posed group.

Distant view across a basketball court after a community donation ceremony, one young man at midcourt holding a ball, spectators scattered in bleachers. Human figure small in frame; no readable signs or text. Casual phone photo.

Wide side view from behind a sofa of two teammates at separate gaming PCs during League practice, people small in frame, focus also on lived-in residential gaming room. They wear simple dark team jerseys, no one looks at camera, no readable monitors.

Unposed medium-wide phone photo of the referenced young man in a blue Palmeiras jersey at an arena concourse with basketball crowd softly visible behind. Seen from across a table, hands gesturing mid-conversation, subject not posing. Natural photojournalism.

Candid over-the-shoulder shot of a woman checking a small video camera monitor before filming, reflection shows a doorway and room behind her, not her face close up. Ordinary house interior, monitor blank/unreadable.

Wide photograph of a laptop on a kitchen table during a video call with four small indistinct participant windows, notebook and tea nearby, no readable screen text, home environment, laptop viewed from user side.

A casserole dish and handwritten blank card being left outside a bedroom door in a large shared home, only someone's hand visible at edge, warm but ordinary night lighting, quiet documentary snapshot, no people posing.

Wide candid photo of two young adults playing table tennis in a mansion recreation room, one reaching for a return, both mid-motion and slightly blurred, people not centered, sofa and game table visible, nobody aware of camera.

Top-down casual phone picture of a disassembled handheld game console, tiny screwdriver, screws in a dish and two pairs of hands repairing it on a wooden living-room table. No faces, real imperfect hobby scene.

Documentary-style interview still: the referenced young man wearing blue Palmeiras shirt, seated at a slight angle in an ordinary quiet room, speaking toward an off-camera interviewer, waist-up but not tight portrait, camera at eye level, natural window light, neutral background, authentic press interview.

Candid top-down snapshot of an open backpack on bedroom floor with two adapters, spare cables, small toolkit and notebook packed for a community technology workshop. Slightly messy, no brand names or legible writing.

Distant candid photo in a residential gaming house lounge: coach and young player seated at opposite ends of sofa talking quietly, full room visible, side profile, no posing. Warm normal lamps, no screens or tactics.

A slightly crooked phone snapshot through a hotel room window at dusk: Austin rooftops and highway lights, edge of an open suitcase in foreground, no recognizable landmark or text. Quiet travel moment.

Wide candid group dinner at a long table in a private hotel dining room, several esports players seen from side/back, a tablet propped at the end on a video call with an older man, food and conversation, not posed, tablet screen indistinct.
